cond_0001.intro: The primary function for this position will be to operate the vertical band saw to cut and distribute raw material for fixtures and other jobs as assigned in the Tooling Department. This job will require daily use of SAP to find materials that are stored in the warehouse and have them delivered to Tooling. As a cross-functional team member of this division he or she may also assemble components and perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Read information from blueprints. Set up, adjust, and operate non-production equipment while monitoring the performance of the machine and carrying out operations in proper sequence. Set up fixtures, mount parts in fixtures/components, and perform mechanical assembly using hand and air tools (wrenches, torque wrenches, impact wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, etc.). Use a computer to order raw material, maintain worklogs, and communicate with engineers and customers.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma or equivalent.
Basic experience using mechanical repair and assembly tools including wrenches, screwdrivers, pliers, etc.
Appropriate reading, clerical, and basic math skills including understanding written instructions, maintaining production records, and calculating sums, differences, and fractions.
Preferred Requirements
Experience or training in welding, machining, mechanical repair, or metal working machinery operation.
Work Environment
Manufacturing plant conditions (indoors, with variable temperature and humidity, noise, and dirt). Physical hazards such as powered vehicle, bicycle, and pedestrian traffic, sharp objects, moving machinery, electrical arc-welding equipment, and materials handling. Work with hazardous materials, such as coolant, solvents, oils, grease, & pressurized gases.
Essential Physical Functions
The physical demands for this job are classified as heavy and include the following:
Be able to regularly handle items weighing up to 60 pounds from floor to knuckle.
Be able to regularly pull or push items weighing up to 50 pounds.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 35 pounds from knuckle to shoulder.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 25 pounds from shoulder to overhead.
Job requires frequent standing, sitting, twisting, and bending.
Job requires occasional walking, elevated work, squatting, kneeling, and climbing.

cond_0012.intro: The primary function for this position will be to operate the vertical band saw to cut and distribute raw material for fixtures and other jobs as assigned in the Tooling Department. This job will require daily use of SAP to find materials that are stored in the warehouse and have them delivered to Tooling. As a cross-functional team member of this division he or she may also assemble components and perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0012.responsibilities: Read information from blueprints. Set up, adjust, and operate non-production equipment while monitoring the performance of the machine and carrying out operations in proper sequence. Set up fixtures, mount parts in fixtures/components, and perform mechanical assembly using hand and air tools (wrenches, torque wrenches, impact wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, etc.). Use a computer to order raw material, maintain worklogs, and communicate with engineers and customers.
cond_0012.requirements:
High School Diploma or equivalent, or equivalent practical experience.
Some familiarity with basic mechanical repair and assembly tools such as wrenches, screwdrivers, and pliers — hands-on experience is a plus, but willingness to learn is equally valued.
Reasonable reading, clerical, and basic math skills, including the ability to follow written instructions, keep production records, and work with sums, differences, and fractions.
Any background or training in welding, machining, mechanical repair, or metal working machinery operation would be helpful, though not required.
Work Environment
Manufacturing plant conditions (indoors, with variable temperature and humidity, noise, and dirt). Physical hazards such as powered vehicle, bicycle, and pedestrian traffic, sharp objects, moving machinery, electrical arc-welding equipment, and materials handling. Work with hazardous materials, such as coolant, solvents, oils, grease, & pressurized gases.
Essential Physical Functions
The physical demands for this job are classified as heavy and include the following:
Be able to regularly handle items weighing up to 60 pounds from floor to knuckle.
Be able to regularly pull or push items weighing up to 50 pounds.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 35 pounds from knuckle to shoulder.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 25 pounds from shoulder to overhead.
Job requires frequent standing, sitting, twisting, and bending.
Job requires occasional walking, elevated work, squatting, kneeling, and climbing.

The role requires use of SAP to locate materials stored in the warehouse and arrange delivery to Tooling. The technician may also assemble components and carry out other duties as assigned.
cond_0034.responsibilities:
Read information from blueprints.
Set up, adjust, and operate non-production equipment while monitoring machine performance and carrying out operations in proper sequence.
Set up fixtures, mount parts in fixtures/components, and perform mechanical assembly using hand and air tools (wrenches, torque wrenches, impact wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, etc.).
Use a computer to order raw material, maintain worklogs, and relay information to engineers and customers as required by the task.
cond_0034.requirements:
High School Diploma or equivalent.
Basic familiarity and experience using mechanical repair and assembly tools including wrenches, screwdrivers, pliers, etc.

Experience or training in welding, machining, mechanical repair, or metal working machinery operation would be beneficial.
Work Environment
Manufacturing plant conditions (indoors, with variable temperature and humidity, noise, and dirt). Physical hazards such as powered vehicle, bicycle, and pedestrian traffic, sharp objects, moving machinery, electrical arc-welding equipment, and materials handling. Work with hazardous materials, such as coolant, solvents, oils, grease, & pressurized gases.

Be able to regularly lift items up to 35 pounds from knuckle to shoulder.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 25 pounds from shoulder to overhead.
Job requires frequent standing, sitting, twisting, and bending.

As a cross-functional team member of this division he or she may also assemble components and perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0065.responsibilities: Read information from blueprints. Set up, adjust, and operate non-production equipment while monitoring the performance of the machine and carrying out operations in proper sequence. Set up fixtures, mount parts in fixtures/components, and perform mechanical assembly using hand and air tools (wrenches, torque wrenches, impact wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, etc.). Use a computer to order raw material, maintain worklogs, and communicate with engineers and customers.

High School Diploma or equivalent required; additional technical training or certification strongly preferred.
Demonstrated proficiency with mechanical repair and assembly tools including wrenches, screwdrivers, pliers, etc.
Strong command of reading, clerical, and math skills including understanding written instructions, maintaining production records, and calculating sums, differences, and fractions.
Proven background in welding, machining, mechanical repair, or metal working machinery operation strongly preferred.

cond_0114.intro: The primary function for this position will be to operate the vertical band saw to cut and distribute raw material for fixtures and other jobs as assigned in the Tooling Department. This job will require daily use of SAP to find materials that are stored in the warehouse and have them delivered to Tooling. As a cross-functional team member of this division he or she may also assemble components and perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0114.responsibilities: Read information from blueprints. Set up, adjust, and operate non-production equipment while monitoring the performance of the machine and carrying out operations in proper sequence. Set up fixtures, mount parts in fixtures/components, and perform mechanical assembly using hand and air tools (wrenches, torque wrenches, impact wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, etc.). Use a computer to order raw material, maintain worklogs, and regularly communicate with engineers and customers to clarify requirements and stay aligned on job needs.
cond_0114.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma or equivalent.
Basic familiarity and hands-on experience with mechanical repair and assembly tools including wrenches, screwdrivers, pliers, etc.
Appropriate reading, clerical, and basic math skills including understanding written instructions, maintaining production records, and calculating sums, differences, and fractions.
Preferred Requirements
Experience or training in welding, machining, mechanical repair, or metal working machinery operation.
Work Environment
Manufacturing plant conditions (indoors, with variable temperature and humidity, noise, and dirt). Physical hazards such as powered vehicle, bicycle, and pedestrian traffic, sharp objects, moving machinery, electrical arc-welding equipment, and materials handling. Work with hazardous materials, such as coolant, solvents, oils, grease, & pressurized gases.
Essential Physical Functions
The physical demands for this job are classified as heavy and include the following:
Be able to regularly handle items weighing up to 60 pounds from floor to knuckle.
Be able to regularly pull or push items weighing up to 50 pounds.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 35 pounds from knuckle to shoulder.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 25 pounds from shoulder to overhead.
Job requires frequent standing, sitting, twisting, and bending.
Job requires occasional walking, elevated work, squatting, kneeling, and climbing.

cond_0171.intro: We are looking for a Mechanical Technician to join our team. The primary function for this position will be to operate the vertical band saw to cut and distribute raw material for fixtures and other jobs as assigned in the Tooling Department. This role involves working alongside team members to use SAP to find materials stored in the warehouse and coordinate their delivery to Tooling. As a cross-functional team member of this division, you may also collaborate on assembling components and support other duties as assigned.
cond_0171.responsibilities:
Read information from blueprints. Work with the team to set up, adjust, and operate non-production equipment while monitoring machine performance and carrying out operations in proper sequence. Coordinate the setup of fixtures, mount parts in fixtures/components, and support mechanical assembly using hand and air tools (wrenches, torque wrenches, impact wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, etc.). Use a computer to help order raw material, maintain worklogs, and communicate with engineers and customers.
Work Environment
Manufacturing plant conditions (indoors, with variable temperature and humidity, noise, and dirt). Physical hazards such as powered vehicle, bicycle, and pedestrian traffic, sharp objects, moving machinery, electrical arc-welding equipment, and materials handling. Work with hazardous materials, such as coolant, solvents, oils, grease, & pressurized gases.
Essential Physical Functions
The physical demands for this job are classified as heavy and include the following:
Be able to regularly handle items weighing up to 60 pounds from floor to knuckle.
Be able to regularly pull or push items weighing up to 50 pounds.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 35 pounds from knuckle to shoulder.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 25 pounds from shoulder to overhead.
Job requires frequent standing, sitting, twisting, and bending.
Job requires occasional walking, elevated work, squatting, kneeling, and climbing.
cond_0171.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma or equivalent.
Basic familiarity with mechanical repair and assembly tools including wrenches, screwdrivers, pliers, etc.
Appropriate reading, clerical, and basic math skills including understanding written instructions, maintaining production records, and calculating sums, differences, and fractions.
Preferred Requirements
Experience or training in welding, machining, mechanical repair, or metal working machinery operation.

This job will require daily use of SAP to find materials that are stored in the warehouse and have them delivered to Tooling. As a cross-functional team member of this division he or she may also assemble components and perform other duties as assigned. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with mechanical assembly and tooling work.
cond_0266.responsibilities:
Read information from blueprints. Set up, adjust, and operate non-production equipment while monitoring the performance of the machine and carrying out operations in proper sequence. Set up fixtures, mount parts in fixtures/components, and perform mechanical assembly using hand and air tools (wrenches, torque wrenches, impact wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, etc.). Use a computer to order raw material, maintain worklogs, and communicate with engineers and customers.
Work Environment
Manufacturing plant conditions (indoors, with variable temperature and humidity, noise, and dirt). Physical hazards such as powered vehicle, bicycle, and pedestrian traffic, sharp objects, moving machinery, electrical arc-welding equipment, and materials handling. Work with hazardous materials, such as coolant, solvents, oils, grease, & pressurized gases.
Essential Physical Functions
The physical demands for this job are classified as heavy and include the following:
Be able to regularly handle items weighing up to 60 pounds from floor to knuckle.
Be able to regularly pull or push items weighing up to 50 pounds.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 35 pounds from knuckle to shoulder.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 25 pounds from shoulder to overhead.
Job requires frequent standing, sitting, twisting, and bending.
Job requires occasional walking, elevated work, squatting, kneeling, and climbing.
cond_0266.requirements:
High School Diploma or equivalent.
Be familiar with and have basic experience using mechanical repair and assembly tools including wrenches, screwdrivers, pliers, etc.
Have appropriate reading, clerical, and basic math skills including understanding written instructions, maintaining production records, and calculating sums, differences, and fractions.
Experience or training in welding, machining, mechanical repair, or metal working machinery operation would be beneficial.

As a cross-functional team member of this division he or she may also assemble components and perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0372.responsibilities: Read information from blueprints. Set up, adjust, and operate non-production equipment while monitoring the performance of the machine and carrying out operations in proper sequence. Set up fixtures, mount parts in fixtures/components, and perform mechanical assembly using hand and air tools (wrenches, torque wrenches, impact wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, etc.). Use a computer to order raw material, maintain worklogs, and communicate with engineers and customers.
cond_0372.requirements:
High School Diploma or equivalent, or equivalent practical experience.
Some familiarity with basic mechanical repair and assembly tools such as wrenches, screwdrivers, and pliers — hands-on experience is a plus, but willingness to learn is equally valued.
Reasonable reading, clerical, and basic math skills, including the ability to follow written instructions, keep production records, and work with sums, differences, and fractions.
Any background or training in welding, machining, mechanical repair, or metal working machinery operation would be helpful, though not required.
Work Environment
Manufacturing plant conditions (indoors, with variable temperature and humidity, noise, and dirt). Physical hazards such as powered vehicle, bicycle, and pedestrian traffic, sharp objects, moving machinery, electrical arc-welding equipment, and materials handling. Work with hazardous materials, such as coolant, solvents, oils, grease, & pressurized gases.
Essential Physical Functions
The physical demands for this job are classified as heavy and include the following:
Be able to regularly handle items weighing up to 60 pounds from floor to knuckle.
Be able to regularly pull or push items weighing up to 50 pounds.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 35 pounds from knuckle to shoulder.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 25 pounds from shoulder to overhead.
Job requires frequent standing, sitting, twisting, and bending.
Job requires occasional walking, elevated work, squatting, kneeling, and climbing.
cond_0372.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0436.intro: The primary function for this position will be to operate the vertical band saw to cut and distribute raw material for fixtures and other jobs as assigned in the Tooling Department. This job will require daily use of SAP to find materials that are stored in the warehouse and have them delivered to Tooling. As a cross-functional team member of this division he or she may also assemble components and perform other duties as assigned. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of mechanical assembly and material handling work.
cond_0436.responsibilities: Read information from blueprints. Set up, adjust, and operate non-production equipment while monitoring the performance of the machine and carrying out operations in proper sequence. Set up fixtures, mount parts in fixtures/components, and perform mechanical assembly using hand and air tools (wrenches, torque wrenches, impact wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, etc.). Use a computer to order raw material, maintain worklogs, and communicate with engineers and customers.
cond_0436.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma or equivalent.
Be familiar with and have basic experience using mechanical repair and assembly tools including wrenches, screwdrivers, pliers, etc.
Have appropriate reading, clerical, and basic math skills including understanding written instructions, maintaining production records, and calculating sums, differences, and fractions.
Preferred Requirements
Experience or training in welding, machining, mechanical repair, or metal working machinery operation.
Work Environment
Manufacturing plant conditions (indoors, with variable temperature and humidity, noise, and dirt). Physical hazards such as powered vehicle, bicycle, and pedestrian traffic, sharp objects, moving machinery, electrical arc-welding equipment, and materials handling. Work with hazardous materials, such as coolant, solvents, oils, grease, & pressurized gases.
Essential Physical Functions
The physical demands for this job are classified as heavy and include the following:
Be able to regularly handle items weighing up to 60 pounds from floor to knuckle.
Be able to regularly pull or push items weighing up to 50 pounds.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 35 pounds from knuckle to shoulder.
Be able to regularly lift items up to 25 pounds from shoulder to overhead.
Job requires frequent standing, sitting, twisting, and bending.
Job requires occasional walking, elevated work, squatting, kneeling, and climbing.

High School Diploma or equivalent.
Basic familiarity and hands-on experience with mechanical repair and assembly tools including wrenches, screwdrivers, pliers, etc.

Manufacturing plant conditions (indoors, with variable temperature and humidity, noise, and dirt). Be able to regularly lift items up to 25 pounds from shoulder to overhead.
Job requires frequent standing, sitting, twisting, and bending.
Job requires occasional walking, elevated work, squatting, kneeling, and climbing.
